Yuqi Yang

Ph.D. Candidate in Supply Chain Management

Hi, I’m Yuqi.

I am a Ph.D. candidate in the NASPO Department of Supply Chain Management at the W. P. Carey School of Business, Arizona State University. I expect to complete my Ph.D. in 2027.

My research focuses on online platform operations, pricing and revenue management, consumer choice and demand estimation, and product development and experimentation. I use analytical modeling and statistical estimation to study these problems.

My advisors are Hongmin Li, Harish Guda, and Binghan Kou.

Before joining ASU, I earned an M.S. in Supply Chain Management from Rensselaer Polytechnic Institute and a B.A. in English, with a second major in finance, from Sichuan University.
